**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Yellow rice with some green herbs or flecks
- Cooked chicken pieces with a glossy, lightly fatty surface

No separate sauce or dressing is clearly visible.

- Greens: 160 ml × 0.2 ≈ 30 g

**STEP 6 - Energy:**
- Rice (turmeric rice, some oil): ~140 kcal/100 g → 66 g ≈ 92 kcal
- Chicken (cooked, some skin/fat): ~190 kcal/100 g → 69 g ≈ 131 kcal
- Spinach/chard (cooked): ~23 kcal/100 g → 30 g ≈ 7 kcal

**STEP 7 - Sanity check:** Total ≈ 165 g and ≈ 230 kcal. This fits a single modest plate. The greens are light and the rice and chicken make up most of the mass. The estimate is plausible, though the rice and chicken weights depend on how deep the pieces are, so the uncertainty is roughly ±25%.
